IOS_UPDATE.description: Problems installing, updating, or operating after an iOS/macOS software update.

BATTERY_POWER.description: Battery drain, charging, power, or battery-life problems.

PERFORMANCE_STABILITY.description: Slowness, freezing, crashing, restarting, hanging, or general device instability.

CONNECTIVITY.description: Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, cellular, network, or connection problems.

APPS_MEDIA.description: Problems involving Apple apps, media, messaging, music, photos, video, or other software services.

DEVICE_HARDWARE.description: Physical device faults, hardware failures, damaged components, or hardware repair questions.

FEATURE_HOW_TO.description: Questions about how to use, configure, or understand an Apple feature.

ACCOUNT_SECURITY.description: Apple ID, password, authentication, account access, or security-related problems.

PURCHASE_REPAIR_WARRANTY.description: Purchases, orders, reservations, accessories, repairs, service appointments, or warranty questions.

OTHER_UNCLEAR.description: Insufficient or ambiguous information to assign a reliable support intent.
